changelog: v1.0.0: Brand identity profiler using Gemini Flash + Google Search grounding. Generates comprehensive JSON profiles for ad generation workflows (Product to Ads, Morpheus, etc).
summary: Analyze brands to generate comprehensive brand identity profiles (JSON). Use when the user wants to analyze a brand, create a brand profile, or needs brand data for ad generation. Stores profiles for reuse across Ad-Ready, Morpheus, and other creative workflows. Can list existing profiles and update them.
